data.name: ImportExcelDesc
data.value: Imports Excel or CSV files and exposes the parsed data as JSON. Parses automatically on file selection.

data.name: BoundFieldValue
data.value: Bound field required by the field template (not used by the parsing logic).

data.name: DisplayModeDesc
data.value: Choose how the control renders: Card (rich UI with dropzone and title) or Button (compact button only).

data.name: ShowTitleDesc
data.value: Show or hide the component title (Card mode only).

data.name: TitleDesc
data.value: Custom title text for the component (Card mode only).

data.name: ShowUserGuidelinesDesc
data.value: Show or hide the user guidelines area (Card mode only).

data.name: UserGuidelinesTextDesc
data.value: Text shown to the end user as usage guidelines (Card mode only).

data.name: ShowStatusDesc
data.value: Show or hide the status panel below the dropzone (Card mode only).

data.name: IncludeFileNameDesc
data.value: Include the source file name on each parsed row.

data.name: DropzonePrimaryTextDesc
data.value: Primary text shown inside the dropzone (Card mode only).

data.name: DropzoneHintTextDesc
data.value: Small hint text shown below the dropzone primary text (Card mode only).

data.name: ButtonTextDesc
data.value: Label for the import button (Button mode only).

data.name: RemoveButtonTextDesc
data.value: Label for the remove file button on the file chip (Card mode only).

data.name: AccentColorDesc
data.value: Primary accent color used for interactive highlights (link, hover border, focus). Hex format (e.g. #323130).

data.name: BackgroundColorDesc
data.value: Background color of the card or button. Hex format (e.g. #ffffff).

data.name: BorderColorDesc
data.value: Border color of the card or button. Hex format (e.g. #e1dfdd).

data.name: AllowMultipleFilesDesc
data.value: Allow the user to select more than one file at a time.

data.name: HasTableDesc
data.value: If true, parses a named Excel table instead of a worksheet range.

data.name: TableNameDesc
data.value: Name of the Excel table to parse (used when Has Table is enabled).

data.name: SheetIndexDesc
data.value: Zero-based index of the worksheet to parse.

data.name: MaxRowsToScanDesc
data.value: Maximum number of rows to scan when detecting the header row (5-200, default 50).

data.name: EnableTraceDesc
data.value: Enable detailed trace logging on the trace output property.

data.name: ResetSignalDesc
data.value: Toggle this value to reset the control and clear all selected files. Use Set(varReset, !varReset) on a button.

data.name: JsonResultDesc
data.value: Parsed data serialized as a JSON array.

data.name: MetaDesc
data.value: Metadata about the parsing operation (files, mode, headers, etc.).

data.name: TraceDesc
data.value: Detailed trace log when Enable Trace is true.

data.name: IsValidDesc
data.value: True when the last parsing attempt completed successfully.

data.name: ErrorMessageDesc
data.value: Human-readable error message when parsing fails.
